photo.alt: Aerial view of Amsterdam and its canal rings

facts: About 942,000 people (2026) in the city proper
About 2 m below sea level, at the mouth of the Amstel
worth_knowing: The name means "Dam in the Amstel": the city began as a fishing village in the 12th century at a dammed river mouth. It is nicknamed the "Venice of the North" for its canals.
